name: Seereth Stonebreak
summary: Near Greatwood Vale, Seereth Stonebreak watches the land's disturbances. The orc shaman camps on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens, guiding travelers against environmental ruin, rogue machines, and rising tensions in Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Watchful Shaman
sections.body: Seereth Stonebreak watches over Horde lands from her camp near Greatwood Vale. An orc shaman, she follows the harmony of the elements and protects the territories of the Horde. The land's spirits cried out against goblin plunder, and the Horde sent her to Stonetalon. There, she watches the landscape and guides travelers against dangers threatening the wild frontier.

sections.title: Turmoil in Stonetalon
sections.body: Seereth Stonebreak is troubled by turmoil across the Stonetalon range. Ruthless goblin ventures and mechanical shredders cutting through ancient woodlands have badly fractured the mountains' spiritual balance. She sends Horde envoys to confront the invaders and seek counsel from elder lorekeepers, in hopes of easing the land's distress.

faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman who serves the Horde. She guides travelers heading toward the Stonetalon Mountains against threats to the land and the Horde's presence.

faq.q: Why is Seereth concerned about the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: The Stonetalon Mountains suffer from rampant deforestation, aggressive goblin logging machinery, and heightened conflict. Seereth senses the local spirits' agitation and works to halt the devastation.

faq.q: What happened to her original post?
faq.answer: Seereth's original post remains near Greatwood Vale, on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens. The Horde sent her to Stonetalon, and the camp lies along the road west of the Crossroads.

faq.q: What tasks does Seereth offer to adventurers?
faq.answer: Seereth sends Horde adventurers into Stonetalon to confront Venture Company goblins, dismantle destructive shredding machines, commune with troubled spirits, and consult respected elders such as Magatha Grimtotem.

faq.q: Who is the Elder Crone she mentions?
faq.answer: The Elder Crone is Magatha Grimtotem, a powerful and influential tauren elder who lives on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Seereth consults her for guidance on deep spiritual disturbances.

faq.q: Why is she concerned with goblin operations?
faq.answer: Seereth is concerned because goblin logging operations use mechanical shredders to tear through sacred forests, pollute waterways, and enrage the nature spirits she is sworn to appease.

angles.text: As a shaman, you share Seereth's duty to heal Stonetalon's environmental scars and soothe its agitated spirits.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect critical overland routes and resources from Alliance forces and reckless goblin operations.
As an orc, you share Seereth's return to shamanism and reverence for the natural world, against mindless destruction.
